description: Give one of the brand's numbers back to Twilio or Telnyx: it stops receiving texts and calls and stops being billed, and usually cannot be got back. Without confirm:true nothing is released and you get the number it would release; call again with confirm:true only after the user says yes. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: release_phone_number
title: Release a phone number
